tldr: Evening batch, Aug 13: DeepSeek officially ships V4-Pro and introduces peak/off-peak API pricing with off-peak 50% cheaper from Aug 16, while Anthropic's research Claude pushes a Riemann hypothesis-related lower bound from 41.6% to 67.2%. Hermes Agent ships a script-driven Browser Use mode cutting tokens 48-66% and Pixel Office on VSCode; Claude Cowork lands in the Chrome extension, Qwen3.8-27B's countdown is live, Kimi K3 hits Databricks, and Ramp data suggests corporate willingness to pay for frontier AI has hit a ceiling.

articles.title: DeepSeek Adds Peak/Off-Peak API Pricing — 50% Off Overnight
articles.summary: New V4-lineup pricing with peak/off-peak rates; off-peak is 50% cheaper for flexible workload scheduling. Effective 16:00 UTC, Aug 16.

articles.title: Research Claude Pushes Riemann Hypothesis Bound to 67.2%
articles.summary: An unreleased research Claude raised the proven fraction of Riemann zeta zeros on the critical line from 41.6% to 67.2% — a notable math capability milestone.

articles.title: Hermes Replaces 12 Browser Tools With One Script-Driven Mode
articles.summary: Browser Use mode (browser_use CLI 3.0) swaps a dozen tool schemas for a single script the agent writes, cutting token use 48-66% with no accuracy drop.

articles.title: Hermes Pixel Office Goes Live on VSCode
articles.summary: New VSCode extension + Hermes Agent plugin visualize all your running Hermes agents live, right in the editor.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-27B Countdown Is Live — Release Imminent
articles.summary: Official Hugging Face countdown page is up and the Qwen team is going live — an open-weight drop promising stronger agentic coding than Qwen3.6-27B.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-Max Jumps to #4 on Legal Research Bench
articles.summary: Qwen3.8-Max climbs from #22 to #4 on Legal Research Bench; Qwen-Image-3.0 also debuts on OpenArt.

articles.title: Kimi K3 Goes Live on Databricks
articles.summary: Moonshot's flagship Kimi K3 is now available on Databricks, expanding enterprise distribution.

articles.title: GBrain v0.45.6 Adds 17 Skills, Now Works With Codex and Claude Code
articles.summary: Garry Tan's open-source personal AGI gains 17 new brain skills and integrates with Codex and Claude Code.

articles.title: MatrAIx — Simulating the World With 8.3B Persona Agents
articles.summary: New paper pushes agent-based world simulation to 8.3 billion persona agents — a new scale for large-scale agent simulation.

articles.title: SWE-Bench ProMax Benchmarks Agents on Multilingual Code Refactoring
articles.summary: New benchmark tests coding agents on large-scale multilingual code refactoring — a harder bar than single-language SWE tasks.

articles.title: Hugging Face CTO: 'Open Source AI Summer' in Full Swing
articles.summary: julien_c highlights a hot streak of open-weight releases across modalities from DeepSeek, Meta, NVIDIA, Mistral and more.

articles.title: Fable 5's Slow Adoption — Corporate AI Spend Hits a Ceiling
articles.summary: Fable 5 accounts for just 6% of Anthropic tokens sold, per Ramp data — corporate willingness to pay for frontier AI may have hit a ceiling.

articles.title: Researchers' Recursive Self-Improvement Milestones Are Already Falling
articles.summary: IAPS' Severin Field interviewed 25 researchers about automated AI research; several milestones they predicted are already hit.

articles.title: Claude Cowork Lands in Chrome — Skills & Plugins Hit the Browser
articles.summary: Claude Cowork now runs directly in the side panel of Anthropic's Chrome extension, adding skills and plugins to the browser.
